items:
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required

Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes breathing mask ... etc

Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor

Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor

Isolate the pump mechanically by 
 closing delivery and suction values

Be sure pump must be completely 
 drained
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid. Manual puller.
Feeler gauge, Dial indicator
Vibrometer, Straight edge, Rags.
Check pump capacity, pressure and power .
Check the Noisy of the Pump

Measure vibration level for bearings and compare it with the 
 setting value, then analyze it and determine what to do
Check the Temperature of bearing
Check the leakage of the mechanical seal
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value
Adjust mechanical seal leakage

Check the pump and piping flanges for Leaks and Re-tight if 
 needed
Check the bolts fixation

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be 
 performed every one year as indicated by (Y1) in the above title block.
This pump is used to transfer the filtrated water from the filtrated water 
 storage tank to demineralization unite.
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Mageed Elhenawey, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control Eng. Magdy Hegazy, accepted by 
 eng . Magdy Okba, and approved by eng Saeed Sowan , accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC inspection & quality 
 control general Manager& MPIS coordinator, and certified by Eng Mohamed Nageeb 
 inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes breathing mask ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor
Isolate the pump mechanically by 
 closing delivery and suction values
Be sure pump must be completely 
 drained
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid. Manual puller.
Feeler gauge, Dial indicator
Vibrometer, Straight edge, Rags.
Work to be 
carried out
Pump in 
 operation
Check pump capacity, pressure and power .
Check the Noisy of the Pump
Measure vibration level for bearings and compare it with the 
 setting value, then analyze it and determine what to do
Check the Temperature of bearing
Check the leakage of the mechanical seal
Pump out of operation
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value
Adjust mechanical seal leakage
Check the pump and piping flanges for Leaks and Re-tight if 
 needed
Check the bolts fixation
Starting the Pump
Before starting the pump, the 
following steps should be checked
Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting.
Filling the pump casing with the liquid
Attendance and checking during 
operation of the pump, the following should be checked:
Check of flow rate and delivery head
Check the mechanical seal for leaks
Install coupling guard on flexible coupled unite
Fully open gate valve(if any ) in suction line , 
 and close gate valve in discharge line
Fill suction line with liquid and completely prime pump
